docs.explain:
ROUNDUP and ROUNDDOWN take the same two arguments as ROUND. The difference is the direction. ROUNDUP moves away from zero and ROUNDDOWN moves toward it, so at 0 decimals the answer is the next whole crate up or the last whole crate down.

Here 476 units at twelve to a crate is 39.67. ROUNDUP(B5/12,0) answers 40, because the part crate still ships. ROUNDDOWN answers 39 and leaves 8 units behind.

ROUND would answer 40 on this sheet and 39 as soon as the total fell below 474, so the same formula changes direction when the data moves. Pick the function from what the number is for: crates to order, or crates that are full.
